final: WITH scoped AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, s.pressratio, s.gbsize * 1.0 / s.spanmin AS size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), grp AS (SELECT zoneref, typesite, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(size_per_min) AS avg_spm FROM scoped GROUP BY zoneref, typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_spm) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM grp
